FORMAL IMPLEMENTATION / REPRODUCIBILITY REVIEW — BLOCK

Candidate: cand-1NFG8CC1R6Z4H1SJTCC2VYFPRF
Commit: 34caf555d0b4137d3327c6d8db8783f631d1b653
Tree: 72300b4b435b98bb98f7fa3b62b13eb21b3fd13c
Parent: 84554a52a839d485e8c010c33c39f0de9169d594
Base: 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5
Scope: exactly mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md and mockups/v2.

What passed independently

- git identity, ancestry, exact two-root scope, and diff-check are correct.
- node mockups/v2/verify-manifest.cjs authenticates 26 sources, 33 outputs, 26 reproducible sources, and 16 reproducible outputs; artifact 42f8d04aa75691fa718b969b3c2148df4cb1034cf598e832ff07924eedf97367 and reproducible 5914d1500cc3f2cf825bbd8e5f4072110fc961f291082e403a3318cd7b82cd3b.
- Two unpiped exact-source exporter runs under Chromium 140 exited 0 and reproduced both signed digests. The only full-manifest difference between clean first run and dirty second run was the intentionally unsigned diagnostics.generatorContext.worktreeDirty field.
- A fresh DPR2 screenshot of frozen compact.html is byte-identical to review/compact.png at SHA-256 712b11a1b51b911c172d8b8382a78d313c77d527355d0e862d064c8ee76b89a4 and 2560 by 1600; mutation restoration did not contaminate that plate.
- Chronology Loom and Feature scale-space are real populated frozen plates, not dead tabs. Chronology has a specific crossing mutation. Exact review HTML contains no script or HTTP resource. Required browser ownership audits were clean before and after, and all contexts and browsers closed.
- The renderer-neutral boundary is unchanged: this slice supplies design artifacts and a renderer-gap diagnostic, not a new Intaglio API or story-specific primitive in the generic layer.

Blocking finding I1 — the exact-element self-clipping mutation still passes only through a generic ancestor fallback, and its required self finding is lost.

export.cjs:514-523 now correctly starts clippingChain at the evidence element, and 525-547 computes a clippedEvidence record with self=true. But 549-592 runs reachability next and returns early at 580-587. The signed receipt therefore records both one-pixel-outer-clipping-ancestor and one-pixel-self-clipping-evidence with the identical diagnostic observation-clipped-by-ancestor. At 1380-1393 the mutation is accepted either by a selfClipFinding or by that generic reachability failure.

I compiled the exact source in memory with one non-behavioral diagnostic addition exposing those two local booleans. The exact one-pixel self mutation yielded:

selfFinding: null
reachabilityFallback: true

Thus the candidate detects failure, but does not produce or authenticate the promised exact-element self=true reason. This does not satisfy the prior acceptance condition and cannot distinguish the repaired defect from an unrelated ancestor/reachability failure.

Minimum successor check: plateCourt must preserve the self-clipping finding even if reachability also fails; the self mutation must be killed only by a record for ref s01 with self=true, with no generic fallback accepted. The signed manifest must carry that record. The one-pixel outer-ancestor mutation must still produce a distinct self=false or outer diagnostic. Mutate the self element and separately mutate only its outer wrapper; each test must reject the opposite diagnosis.

Blocking finding I2 — DPR2 is self-referential and a DPR1 mutant passes the full court while the receipt claims DPR2.

The sole constant at export.cjs:23 configures the browser at 1221-1224, is compared with observed DPR at 1321, defines expected pixels at 1435-1441, and is copied into every view at 1457. The renderer description at 1514 is independently hard-coded as DPR 2.

I compiled the exact exporter in memory with only:

const DEVICE_SCALE_FACTOR = 2
changed to
const DEVICE_SCALE_FACTOR = 1

The full exporter exited 0, all 15 DPR1 plates were written, and verify-manifest.cjs passed. The mutated receipt reports deviceScaleFactor 1 and one-to-one natural/CSS dimensions, while artifact.renderer still says Chromium PNG at DPR 2. Mutant digests were artifact 6479471e0463e6b207dd8f2157840df029fae9a9d63dc09b1635a14eb5cd033c and reproducible f6563049d725829849ce5331bf0effa1b715bca9792ce284b302ce34b5351c20. This directly falsifies PROOF-BOUNDARY.md:19-24, which says DPR1 is inadmissible and the exporter fails before receipt.

Minimum successor check: separate immutable REQUIRED_DPR = 2 policy from capture configuration and observed browser DPR. Compare observed DPR and PNG dimensions to REQUIRED_DPR, derive renderer prose from the authenticated observed/required value, and add a recorded mutant that changes only capture DPR to 1. That mutant must exit nonzero before writing a receipt. A verifier must also reject any artifact whose renderer claim, per-view observed DPR, and dimensions disagree.

Blocking finding I3 — PIXEL-REVIEW-BASELINE.md does not identify the immutable predecessor it claims to preserve.

Lines 9-14 name commit dda53463a1556f1b18bfd8a24c937d439fc89dfc but record tree 7fd21cafc60e317f24044bf44fb38a6081606357, artifact digest 3dd04832c0f0406bcb743effc582f9a78fdbe4f9c092e6de914d6443efaa1f32, and reproducible digest d3a378c361802a78e62ec6221d96e3dcbfa42287344a4e2fce5b91caa29a1ec2. Direct Git-object verification gives tree 7fd21caf66b562c48c635ba38844ad00ffd7303b, artifact 3dd04832dbbe9a3501f5af3048378a62d9809362aa10e04164ac550835dca9e8, and reproducible d3a378c3444d3e6d435ba6b1f9e4663499be52a895bb03fb9b0f13d5f84a5530. The per-output hash ledger does match the old manifest; the three identity-level values do not. Because this file is itself a signed source, the current manifest faithfully authenticates false provenance.

Minimum successor check: regenerate those three values from git rev-parse dda53463^{tree} and the predecessor manifest object, then add a court that parses every immutable baseline identity and verifies commit-to-tree and manifest-to-digest equality. A typo or one-nibble mutation in any value must fail.

Blocking finding I4 — the proof text overstates mutation evidence for the new Feature plate.

PROOF-BOUNDARY.md:53-59 says the named Chronology, Feature, recall, motion, and State checks each have a killing mutation. chronologyCourt has one, but featureScaleCourt at export.cjs:1061-1085 only snapshots, checks, and returns. The signed featureScaleChecks contains no mutation field. The Mote evidence accurately says Feature requires its counts, but the signed proof boundary says more.

Minimum successor check: either add and record discriminating mutations for the Feature raw marks, missing region, window styles, and receipt, or narrow the proof text to the exact checks that really have mutations. At minimum, removing one raw mark and removing the missing-region mark must independently fail for the intended reason and be recorded in the signed artifact.

Exact commands and evidence boundary

- git rev-parse HEAD^{commit} HEAD^{tree} HEAD^; git rev-parse dda53463^{tree}; git show dda53463:mockups/v2/review/manifest.json
- node mockups/v2/verify-manifest.cjs
- NODE_PATH=<authoritative e2e/static/node_modules> node mockups/v2/export.cjs, unpiped, twice, in a disposable exact-commit clone
- in-memory source compilation for the self-diagnostic probe and the one-constant DPR1 mutant; no candidate source byte was edited
- fresh frozen-HTML screenshot and byte comparison for Compact
- browser-automation-guard.mjs --audit before and after

This is an implementation/reproducibility block only. The science and UX dispositions are separate. I did not edit, stage, authorize, land, or push any candidate path.
